extensionAttribute.description: Minutes of idle time before the display enters sleep on the active power profile.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Display Sleep Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
value=$(/usr/bin/pmset -g custom 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk '/^[[:space:]]*displaysleep[[:space:]]/ { print $2; exit }')
echo "<result>${value:-Unknown}</result>"
